Status: DRAFT
⌈
Service Name
EthIf_EthGetSpiStatus (draft)
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthIf_EthGetSpiStatus (
uint8* CtrlIdx,
Eth_SpiStatusType* SpiStatusPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x6a
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
CtrlIdx
Index of the controller within the context of the Ethernet Interface.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
SpiStatusPtr
Status of the SPI interface
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: success.
E_NOT_OK: Controller request has not been accepted.
Description
When MACPHY controller are used, obtains the SPI interface status.

EthIf.h
